unit: The USA 1945-1974: The People and the State
title: Feminism and the women's movement

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of Betty Friedan, NOW, the ERA fight and the Stonewall riots — gender and sexuality politics 1960s-70s.

items.title: The Second Wave Feminist Movement (1960s-1970s): The Struggle for Equality
items.description: Clear overview of second-wave feminism — Friedan, NOW, ERA ratification battles and the limits of the movement. 12 min.

items.title: The 1960s in America: Crash Course US History #40
items.description: John Green covers the women's movement alongside other 1960s rights movements — useful for the broader context. 14 min.

items.title: Mrs. America (2020)
items.description: FX series dramatising the ERA battle — Phyllis Schlafly vs the feminist movement, with an all-star cast. Brilliant for this topic.

items.title: The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel (2017)
items.description: 1950s New York woman finding her voice — captures the social constraints that second-wave feminism was pushing against.

items.title: Khan Academy — Women and 1960s Social Movements
items.description: Free revision covering the women's movement, ERA and the limits of social change in 1960s-70s America.

items.title: OCR History B J411 — Specification
items.description: Official OCR J411 spec — check the assessment criteria for the USA People and the State unit.
